title: 10 Y/O Loves Them
text:
Makes Geography fun! I homeschool and we use this as a fun substitute at the end of Geography class. My 10 year old daughters loves it. They're not that challenging for her but they're fun and interesting.

Update: My daughter is now 12 and we are very close to completing all 50 states. This ended up being very expensive in the long run and I don’t believe my daughter learned very much other than a few irrelevant state facts, which she probably won’t remember 2 years from now. She still likes doing the puzzles, but I honestly wouldn’t do this again. The price is too high and the educational value is too low.

Update: We had only three states left and they kept sending us duplicates. I regret ever starting this. I have cancelled it.
